summary.ja_easy: {日本|にほん}の{外|そと}から{来|き}て{住|す}み{始|はじ}めたら、{区役所|くやくしょ}で{転入|てんにゅう}{届|とどけ}を{出|だ}します。{在留|ざいりゅう}カード（または{旅券|りょけん}）を{持|も}って{行|い}きます。{転入|てんにゅう}{届|とどけ}を{出|だ}すと、{入管|にゅうかん}への{住所|じゅうしょ}のとどけも{済|す}みます。{入管|にゅうかん}へ{別|べつ}に{行|い}かなくてかまいません。お{金|かね}はかかりません。{窓口|まどぐち}で、{在留|ざいりゅう}カードの{裏|うら}に{住所|じゅうしょ}を{書|か}いてもらいます。
summary.en: After you start living in Nagoya, file a moving-in notice at the Citizens Section of your ward office (the Ward Residents Section at a branch office). Bring your residence card (or passport). Filing it counts as your residence-address notification to Immigration, so you do not need a separate visit to Immigration. No fee. At the counter, your address is written on the back of your residence card.

text.en: Within 14 days; the day after you set your place of residence is day 1. If day 14 is a closed day, the next open day is the deadline (to be checked). Go as early as you can.

evidence.quote: （住所を異動した日の翌日が、１日目となります。）

text.ja_easy: {住|す}む{区|く}の{区役所|くやくしょ}の{市民|しみん}{課|か}（{支所|ししょ}は{区民|くみん}{生活|せいかつ}{課|か}）

text.en: Bring: the passport of everyone moving in, and something that shows the date of entry (not needed if the passport shows it).

text.en: Bring: the residence card (or special permanent resident certificate) of everyone moving in. If you do not have the card yet, show a passport stamped to say it will be issued later (to be checked).

text.ja_easy: {新|あたら}しい{世帯|せたい}の{世帯|せたい}{主|ぬし}が{外国|がいこく}{人|じん}のときは、{世帯|せたい}{主|ぬし}との{関係|かんけい}を{証明|しょうめい}する{書類|しょるい}の{原本|げんぽん}が{要|い}ります（{外国|がいこく}{語|ご}の{書類|しょるい}には、{日本語|にほんご}の{訳|やく}をつけます）。
text.en: If the head of the new household is a foreign resident, bring the original document that proves your relationship to the head (with a translation if it is in a foreign language).

text.en: If you handed in your My Number Card when you left Japan, or filed to keep using it, bring it too.

text.en: The person moving, or a relative who lives with them, can file. For a child under 16, a relative aged 16 or over who lives with them files.
